1.c4 e5 2.e3 Nf6 3.f4.strategy: An aggressive try that challenges e5 at once and aims for the open f-file. It loosens White's pawns and weakens the diagonal towards the king, so Black can develop calmly and reach a comfortable game. Offbeat rather than bad.

1.c4 e5 2.e3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4.strategy: Takes the pawn. If White retakes with the e-pawn, the position opens without harm to Black; if White offers the pawn as a gambit instead, Black has to answer quick development with care.
